description: A list of distinct receipts identified in the image. Extract data for each receipt separately.

remarked_telephone.description: The handwritten 8-digit number written at the very top of the receipt paper (e.g., '92300131'). If not strictly 8 digits or not found, return null.

invoice_number.description: The printed Invoice Number (e.g., found next to '賬單號碼', starting with characters like 'PP3').

shop_code.description: The 3-character shop abbreviation derived from the first 3 letters of the Invoice Number (e.g., if Invoice No is 'PP31206...', shop code is 'PP3').

invoice_issue_date.description: The checkout date and time found next to '結賬時間'. Convert the format to strict ISO 8601: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss'.

payment_method.description: The method of payment found under '付款方法' (e.g., '八達通付款', 'Spectra-Visa/Master').

total_amount.description: The Grand Total amount found next to '總計'.
